component_destinations.current_actual_clause: The alternative is the logbook method. Once the pool is chosen for a year, every asset of that year between its bounds goes into it (§ 6(2a) sentence 5 EStG). The 2026 EÜR instructions allow a one-year useful life for computer hardware and software. Under § 6(2) sentences 2–3, an asset is not independently usable if its business purpose requires it to be used only together with other fixed assets and those assets are technically coordinated; possible transfer into another such context does not itself cure that dependency. For an immediate write-off above EUR 250, the separate register is unnecessary if the required acquisition date and value particulars are already evident from the books. The GWG/pool eligibility cost excludes contained VAT; recoverability separately determines actual expense/acquisition cost under § 9b, rather than making every low-priced component eligible.

component_destinations.current_actual_clause: This Guide presents planning mechanisms and does not rank products or legal forms or calculate a real client's saving. The historical numerical fixtures are retained in the old-topic evidence: their assumed rates and period figures were not reliable current tax results. Official sources need not print a fictional case's numbers for a source-based computation to be valid. For a real comparison apply the actual § 32a tariff with and without the item, including the applicable deductions, caps and interactions; do not assume a constant marginal rate without checking the entire affected taxable-income interval. The five mechanisms below remain. Example 2 stipulates an eligible isolated self-payer with no employer contribution offset or special cap reduction; Example 4 stipulates an actually qualifying independently usable depreciable movable fixed asset. These facts qualify those examples; the general employee pension and asset selectors above still apply.

component_destinations.current_actual_clause: The alternative is the logbook method. Once the pool is chosen for a year, every asset of that year between its bounds goes into it (§ 6(2a) sentence 5 EStG). The 2026 EÜR instructions allow a one-year useful life for computer hardware and software. Under § 6(2) sentences 2–3, an asset is not independently usable if its business purpose requires it to be used only together with other fixed assets and those assets are technically coordinated; possible transfer into another such context does not itself cure that dependency. For an immediate write-off above EUR 250, the separate register is unnecessary if the required acquisition date and value particulars are already evident from the books. The GWG/pool eligibility cost excludes contained VAT; recoverability separately determines actual expense/acquisition cost under § 9b, rather than making every low-priced component eligible.

component_destinations.current_actual_clause: The alternative is the logbook method. Once the pool is chosen for a year, every asset of that year between its bounds goes into it (§ 6(2a) sentence 5 EStG). The 2026 EÜR instructions allow a one-year useful life for computer hardware and software. Under § 6(2) sentences 2–3, an asset is not independently usable if its business purpose requires it to be used only together with other fixed assets and those assets are technically coordinated; possible transfer into another such context does not itself cure that dependency. For an immediate write-off above EUR 250, the separate register is unnecessary if the required acquisition date and value particulars are already evident from the books. The GWG/pool eligibility cost excludes contained VAT; recoverability separately determines actual expense/acquisition cost under § 9b, rather than making every low-priced component eligible.

section: Tax planning for the self-employed in Germany (Steueroptimierung)
wording: The statutory rules behind the usual ways a self-employed person in Germany lowers income tax, trade tax, VAT and social contributions: for each idea the rule, its conditions, its limit and what stops it. This Guide never computes a saving and does not rank options. Figures are for tax year 2026, from the federal law pages, the ministry instructions for the 2026 EÜR form (ministry letter of 1 September 2026) and 2026 pension insurer pages. One source is dated another year: the ministry booklet "Steuern von A bis Z" is the 2025 edition, used only for the marginal income tax rates, the church tax rates and the lowest trade tax multiplier, because the statute prints those as factors, not at all, or already in its 2027 version. Rates set for later years are marked as not for 2026.
